[[1961 Minnesota Vikings season|Minnesota Vikings]] | first_round = | fewnum = 14 | fewest = [[1961 Pittsburgh Steelers season|Pittsburgh Steelers]] | mostnum = 26 | most = [[1961 San Francisco 49ers season|San Francisco 49ers]] | overall = 280 | rounds = 20 | hofnum = {{ Collapsible list | title = 7 | 1 = TE [[Mike Ditka]] | 2 = CB [[Jimmy Johnson (cornerback)|James Earl “Jimmy” Johnson]] | 3 = DT [[Bob Lilly]] | 4 = CB [[Herb Adderley]] | 5 = QB [[Fran Tarkenton]] | 6 = G [[Billy Shaw]] | 7 = DE [[Deacon Jones|David “Deacon” Jones]] }} | prev = [[1960 NFL draft|1960]] | next = [[1962 NFL draft|1962]] }} The '''1961 NFL draft''' took place at the [[The Warwick|Warwick Hotel]] in [[Philadelphia]] on December 27–28, 1960.{{cite web |url=http://www.footballgeography.com/nfl-draft-sites/ |title=NFL Draft Locations |date=October 2, 2014 |website=www.footballgeography.com |access-date=2014-10-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150905090250/http://www.footballgeography.com/nfl-draft-sites/ |archive-date=2015-09-05 |url-status=dead }}{{cite news|last1=Salomone|first1=Dan|title=NFL Draft headed to Chicago in 2015|url=http://www.giants.com/news-and-blogs/article-1/NFL-Draft-headed-to-Chicago-in-2015/3ac322b1-3b4c-4a16-aba7-6e08d31b1756|access-date=June 3, 2015|publisher=[[New York Giants]]|work=Giants.com|date=October 2, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150930065327/http://www.giants.com/news-and-blogs/article-1/NFL-Draft-headed-to-Chicago-in-2015/3ac322b1-3b4c-4a16-aba7-6e08d31b1756|archive-date=2015-09-30|url-status=dead}} The league would later hold an [[1961 NFL expansion draft|expansion draft]] for the [[Minnesota Vikings]] expansion franchise. This draft was also the first regular draft for the [[Dallas Cowboys]] as they had only participated in the [[1960 NFL expansion draft]] that year. The Cowboys held the worst record in the NFL the [[1960 NFL season|previous season]], but selected second in this draft because the expansion Vikings were awarded the [[List of first overall National Football League Draft picks|first overall pick]].
